narrative.text: "Zycus - UniSan S2P Implementation" is assessed as Red as of 2026-08-17. Schedule slippage is Red: 138 of 170 active tasks (81.2%) are past their end date without being completed. 19 overdue task(s) are on the critical path (e.g. "iSource Configuration Documentation Workshop"), which is why the critical-path override is Red. Milestone health is Red: 23.1% of major phases are overdue (Training Phase I, Hypercare Phase I, Configuration Validation & Documentation, eProc and eInvoice and Merlin APSD, Contract Management with Basic Setup, Supplier Information Management with Integration, iSource Configuration, Merlin Intake Configuration, Value KPI Sign-off). No stakeholder comment data is available for this project, so sentiment could not be assessed.
